name: TaserDerby
shortDescription: Physics-based race-betting sim — lose your bet and an ESP32-C3 fires a real physical penalty pulse via a relay. Built at GoOnHacks 2025.
description:
TaserDerby is a physics-based simulation where users bet on microscopic racers competing toward a goal. When a bet loses, the web app fires an HTTP request to an ESP32-C3 microcontroller, which activates a relay for a 'physical penalty pulse' — merging digital outcomes with real-world consequences.

Built at GoOnHacks (November 2025).
